146	/// Move cursor one word left (Alt+Left) — stops at START of current word
147	pub fn input_move_word_left(s: &mut InputState) {
148	    clear_selection(s);
149	    if s.cursor_col == 0 {
150	        if s.cursor_line > 0 {
151	            s.cursor_line -= 1;
152	            s.cursor_col = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
153	        }
154	        return;
155	    }
156	    let chars: Vec<char> = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().collect();
157	    let mut i = s.cursor_col;
158	    // skip word chars backward (go to start of current word)
159	    while i > 0 && chars[i - 1] != ' ' { i -= 1; }
160	    // if already at start of word, skip spaces then go to start of previous word
161	    if i == s.cursor_col {
162	        while i > 0 && chars[i - 1] == ' ' { i -= 1; }
163	        while i > 0 && chars[i - 1] != ' ' { i -= 1; }
164	    }
165	    s.cursor_col = i;
166	}
167	
168	/// Move cursor one word right (Alt+Right) — stops at END of current word
169	pub fn input_move_word_right(s: &mut InputState) {
170	    clear_selection(s);
171	    let line_len = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().count();
172	    if s.cursor_col == line_len {
173	        if s.cursor_line + 1 < s.lines.len() {
174	            s.cursor_line += 1;
175	            s.cursor_col = 0;
176	        }
177	        return;
178	    }
179	    let chars: Vec<char> = s.lines[s.cursor_line].chars().collect();
180	    let mut i = s.cursor_col;
181	    // skip leading spaces first
182	    while i < chars.len() && chars[i] == ' ' { i += 1; }
183	    // skip to end of word
184	    while i < chars.len() && chars[i] != ' ' { i += 1; }
185	    s.cursor_col = i;
186	}

188	/// Set anchor if not set, move cursor, update selection.
189	/// Selection bounds are stored to match the visually highlighted region:
190	/// - Right (anchor <= cursor): [anchor, cursor) — anchor char included, cursor char excluded
191	/// - Left  (cursor < anchor):  [cursor+1, anchor+1) — current char included, cursor char excluded
192	fn extend_selection(s: &mut InputState, move_fn: fn(&mut InputState)) {
193	    if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {
194	        s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));
195	    }
196	    let anchor = s.selection_anchor;
197	    move_fn(s); // clears selection_anchor, restore after
198	    s.selection_anchor = anchor;
199	    if let Some(anchor_pt) = s.selection_anchor {
200	        let cursor = (s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col);
201	        if anchor_pt == cursor {
202	            s.selection = None;
203	            s.selection_anchor = None;
204	        } else if cursor < anchor_pt {
205	            // Left-extending: visually highlight (cursor, anchor] = [cursor+1, anchor+1)
206	            let start = advance_pos(&s.lines, cursor.0, cursor.1);
207	            let end   = advance_pos(&s.lines, anchor_pt.0, anchor_pt.1);
208	            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {
209	                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,
210	                end_line:   end.0,   end_col:   end.1,
211	            });
212	        } else {
213	            // Right-extending: visually highlight [anchor, cursor)
214	            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {
215	                start_line: anchor_pt.0, start_col: anchor_pt.1,
216	                end_line:   cursor.0,   end_col:   cursor.1,
217	            });
218	        }
219	    }
220	}

229	/// Place cursor at (line, col) from a mouse click, optionally extending selection.
230	pub fn input_click(s: &mut InputState, li: usize, ci: usize, extend: bool) {
231	    if extend {
232	        if s.selection_anchor.is_none() {
233	            s.selection_anchor = Some((s.cursor_line, s.cursor_col));
234	        }
235	        s.cursor_line = li;
236	        s.cursor_col = ci;
237	        let anchor = s.selection_anchor.unwrap();
238	        let cursor = (li, ci);
239	        if anchor == cursor {
240	            s.selection = None;
241	            s.selection_anchor = None;
242	        } else {
243	            let (start, end) = if anchor <= cursor { (anchor, cursor) } else { (cursor, anchor) };
244	            s.selection = Some(crate::state::Selection {
245	                start_line: start.0, start_col: start.1,
246	                end_line: end.0, end_col: end.1,
247	            });
248	        }
249	    } else {
250	        s.cursor_line = li;
251	        s.cursor_col = ci;
252	        s.selection = None;
253	        s.selection_anchor = None;
254	    }
255	}

276	fn delete_selection(s: &mut InputState, sel: &Selection) {
277	    let (sl, sc, el, ec) =
278	        if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {
279	            (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)
280	        } else {
281	            (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)
282	        };
283	    if sl == el {
284	        let line = &mut s.lines[sl];
285	        let b_start = char_to_byte_idx(line, sc);
286	        let b_end = char_to_byte_idx(line, ec);
287	        line.drain(b_start..b_end);
288	    } else {
289	        let ec_byte = char_to_byte_idx(&s.lines[el], ec);
290	        let suffix = s.lines[el][ec_byte..].to_string();
291	        let sc_byte = char_to_byte_idx(&s.lines[sl], sc);
292	        s.lines[sl].truncate(sc_byte);
293	        s.lines[sl].push_str(&suffix);
294	        s.lines.drain(sl + 1..=el);
295	    }
296	    s.cursor_line = sl;
297	    s.cursor_col = sc;
298	}

300	fn char_to_byte_idx(s: &str, char_idx: usize) -> usize {

303	        .map(|(b, _)| b)
304	        .unwrap_or(s.len())

315	/// Compute (line_idx, col_idx) from a mouse click at (col, row) inside the input inner area.
316	pub fn cursor_from_mouse(state: &InputState, area: ratatui::layout::Rect, col: u16, row: u16) -> (usize, usize) {
317	    // Inner area starts 1 col in (for border), and first col is ">" prefix (2 chars)
318	    let prefix_w = 2usize; // "> "
319	    let li = (row.saturating_sub(area.y)) as usize;
320	    let li = li.min(state.lines.len().saturating_sub(1));
321	    let rel_col = (col.saturating_sub(area.x)) as usize;
322	    let ci = rel_col.saturating_sub(prefix_w);
323	    let line_len = state.lines[li].chars().count();
324	    (li, ci.min(line_len))
325	}

327	pub fn render_input(
328	    f: &mut Frame,
329	    state: &InputState,
330	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,
331	    focused: bool,
332	    input_rect_out: &mut ratatui::layout::Rect,
333	) {
334	    let border_style = if focused {
335	        Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)
336	    } else {
337	        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)
338	    };
339	
340	    let block = Block::default()
341	        .borders(Borders::ALL)
342	        .border_type(BorderType::Rounded)
343	        .border_style(border_style);
344	
345	    let inner = block.inner(area);
346	    *input_rect_out = inner; // store for mouse click mapping
347	    f.render_widget(block, area);
348	
349	    let visible_height = inner.height as usize;
350	    let total_lines = state.lines.len();
351	
352	    // Scroll to keep cursor visible
353	    let scroll_offset = if total_lines <= visible_height {
354	        0
355	    } else if state.cursor_line < state.scroll_offset {
356	        state.cursor_line
357	    } else if state.cursor_line >= state.scroll_offset + visible_height {
358	        state.cursor_line.saturating_sub(visible_height - 1)
359	    } else {
360	        state.scroll_offset
361	    };
362	
363	    let text_lines: Vec<Line> = state
364	        .lines
365	        .iter()
366	        .enumerate()
367	        .skip(scroll_offset)
368	        .take(visible_height)
369	        .map(|(li, line)| {
370	            let mut spans = Vec::new();
371	
372	            // "> " prefix on first line, "  " on subsequent
373	            let prefix = if li == 0 { "> " } else { "  " };
374	            spans.push(Span::styled(prefix, Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));
375	
376	            let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
377	            for (ci, &ch) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
378	                let is_cursor = li == state.cursor_line && ci == state.cursor_col;
379	                let in_sel = in_selection(state, li, ci);
380	                let style = if is_cursor || in_sel {
381	                    Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)
382	                } else {
383	                    Style::default().fg(Color::White)
384	                };
385	                spans.push(Span::styled(ch.to_string(), style));
386	            }
387	            // Cursor at end of line
388	            if li == state.cursor_line && state.cursor_col == chars.len() {
389	                spans.push(Span::styled(" ", Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)));
390	            }
391	            Line::from(spans)
392	        })
393	        .collect();
394	
395	    let para = Paragraph::new(text_lines);
396	    f.render_widget(para, inner);
397	}
398	
399	fn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {
400	    let Some(sel) = &state.selection else { return false };
401	    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {
402	        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)
403	    } else {
404	        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)
405	    };
406	    if li < sl || li > el { false }
407	    else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }
408	    else if li == sl { ci >= sc }
409	    else if li == el { ci < ec }
410	    else { true }
411	}
412	
413	/// Advance one position in the text (col+1, or next line start).
414	fn advance_pos(lines: &[String], li: usize, ci: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
415	    let line_len = lines[li].chars().count();
416	    if ci < line_len { (li, ci + 1) }
417	    else if li + 1 < lines.len() { (li + 1, 0) }
418	    else { (li, ci) }
419	}

> AGENT

The match arm ordering is correct — Shift+Alt+Arrow is checked before Shift+Arrow.

The problem is likely your terminal. Which terminal are you using? On macOS:

- **Terminal.app**: Sends Shift+Option+Arrow as `\x1b[1;4D`/`\x1b[1;4C` — crossterm should parse this correctly with keyboard enhancement flags.
- **iTerm2**: May need "Report modifiers using CSI u" enabled in Preferences > Profiles > Keys.
- **Some terminals**: Shift+Option+Arrow produces a Unicode character instead of a modified arrow key.

Quick way to debug — add a temporary debug log to see what crossterm actually receives. Want me to add that, or can you tell me which terminal you're running?

Alternatively, I can add more fallback patterns. On many macOS terminals, Shift+Option+Left/Right sends nothing useful — the terminal eats it. A common workaround is to also match on additional escape sequences. But first, which terminal?

399	fn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {
400	    let Some(sel) = &state.selection else { return false };
401	    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {
402	        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)
403	    } else {
404	        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)
405	    };
406	    if li < sl || li > el { false }
407	    else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }
408	    else if li == sl { ci >= sc }
409	    else if li == el { ci < ec }
410	    else { true }
411	}

414	fn advance_pos(lines: &[String], li: usize, ci: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
415	    let line_len = lines[li].chars().count();
416	    if ci < line_len { (li, ci + 1) }
417	    else if li + 1 < lines.len() { (li + 1, 0) }
418	    else { (li, ci) }
419	}

  "file_path": "/Users/4thwithme/Documents/repo/clui/rust/crates/app/src/ui/input.rs",
  "old_string": "/// Compute (line_idx, col_idx) from a mouse click at (col, row) inside the input inner area.\npub fn cursor_from_mouse(state: &InputState, area: ratatui::layout::Rect, col: u16, row: u16) -> (usize, usize) {\n    // Inner area starts 1 col in (for border), and first col is \">\" prefix (2 chars)\n    let prefix_w = 2usize; // \"> \"\n    let li = (row.saturating_sub(area.y)) as usize;\n    let li = li.min(state.lines.len().saturating_sub(1));\n    let rel_col = (col.saturating_sub(area.x)) as usize;\n    let ci = rel_col.saturating_sub(prefix_w);\n    let line_len = state.lines[li].chars().count();\n    (li, ci.min(line_len))\n}",
  "new_string": "/// Compute (line_idx, col_idx) from a mouse click at (col, row) inside the input inner area.\npub fn cursor_from_mouse(state: &InputState, area: ratatui::layout::Rect, col: u16, row: u16) -> (usize, usize) {\n    let prefix_w = 2usize; // \"> \" or \"  \"\n    let wrap_width = (area.width as usize).saturating_sub(prefix_w);\n    let wrap_width = wrap_width.max(1);\n\n    let visual_row = (row.saturating_sub(area.y)) as usize;\n    let rel_col = (col.saturating_sub(area.x)) as usize;\n    let char_col = rel_col.saturating_sub(prefix_w);\n\n    // Walk visual rows to find which logical line + offset\n    let mut vrow = 0usize;\n    for (li, line) in state.lines.iter().enumerate() {\n        let line_len = line.chars().count();\n        let wrapped_rows = if line_len == 0 { 1 } else { (line_len + wrap_width - 1) / wrap_width };\n        if visual_row < vrow + wrapped_rows {\n            // Within this logical line\n            let sub_row = visual_row - vrow;\n            let ci = sub_row * wrap_width + char_col;\n            return (li, ci.min(line_len));\n        }\n        vrow += wrapped_rows;\n    }\n    // Past end — place at end of last line\n    let last = state.lines.len().saturating_sub(1);\n    (last, state.lines[last].chars().count())\n}\n\n/// Count how many visual rows all lines take when wrapped to a given width.\npub fn visual_line_count(state: &InputState, wrap_width: usize) -> usize {\n    let w = wrap_width.max(1);\n    state.lines.iter().map(|line| {\n        let len = line.chars().count();\n        if len == 0 { 1 } else { (len + w - 1) / w }\n    }).sum()\n}"
}

      if vr.li == state.cursor_line\n                && state.cursor_col == line_len\n                && vr.end_ci == line_len\n            {\n                spans.push(Span::styled(\" \", Style::default().bg(Color::White).fg(Color::Black)));\n            }\n            Line::from(spans)\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    let para = Paragraph::new(text_lines);\n    f.render_widget(para, inner);\n}"
}

The scroll offset update in mod.rs uses logical line indices, but `render_input` now handles its own visual-row scrolling. The mod.rs scroll update can be simplified — `render_input` already computes the correct scroll offset internally. But `scroll_offset` is stored on `InputState` and mutated here. Let me make this work with visual rows.

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01TYQJSVwAPyR4L56dSz7z88
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/4thwithme/Documents/repo/clui/rust/crates/app/src/ui/mod.rs",
  "old_string": "                // Update input scroll_offset to keep cursor visible\n                {\n                    let input_inner_height = input_height.saturating_sub(2) as usize; // minus border\n                    let inp = &mut state.tabs.get_mut(active_idx).unwrap().input;\n                    if inp.cursor_line < inp.scroll_offset {\n                        inp.scroll_offset = inp.cursor_line;\n                    } else if inp.cursor_line >= inp.scroll_offset + input_inner_height {\n                        inp.scroll_offset = inp.cursor_line.saturating_sub(input_inner_height - 1);\n                    }\n                }",
  "new_string": "                // Update input scroll_offset to keep cursor visible (visual rows)\n                {\n                    let input_inner_height = input_height.saturating_sub(2) as usize;\n                    let inp = &mut state.tabs.get_mut(active_idx).unwrap().input;\n                    // Compute cursor visual row\n                    let mut cursor_vrow = 0usize;\n                    for (li, line) in inp.lines.iter().enumerate() {\n                        let len = line.chars().count();\n                        let rows = if len == 0 { 1 } else { (len + est_wrap_w - 1) / est_wrap_w };\n                        if li == inp.cursor_line {\n                            let sub = inp.cursor_col / est_wrap_w.max(1);\n                            cursor_vrow += sub;\n                            break;\n                        }\n                        cursor_vrow += rows;\n                    }\n                    if cursor_vrow < inp.scroll_offset {\n                        inp.scroll_offset = cursor_vrow;\n                    } else if cursor_vrow >= inp.scroll_offset + input_inner_height {\n                        inp.scroll_offset = cursor_vrow.saturating_sub(input_inner_height - 1);\n                    }\n                }"
}
